So for tests that call debug we need to set ExecutionConfig with debug disabled false to avoid NPE. ExecutionContext has constructors: ExecutionContext(ExecutionConfig). We can create ExecutionConfig object (likely public). Not provided but we can assume we can instantiate new ExecutionConfig() and set debugEnabled false, annotation collection etc. We'll need to set minimal config.

Instead test fetchSubSchemaNode when suppressSubSchemaRetrieval = true returns null.

Similarly collectAnnotations: need ExecutionContext with ExecutionConfig where annotationCollectionEnabled true and filter returns true.
